body: [opus 5.5] Owner 10:56 ET variant: with the thread UNPACKED the reply joined the thread immediately after the 2nd tick (green never seen); after folding the thread the Sending card was still in the main list with both ticks green: two copies (stale pending card not retired) or a jump back out. Fix: one record per send (op key then Slack id), in exactly one place in every view; test every combination of open/folded thread before/after the 2nd tick. Also (owner 10:54 ET): server_ms=0 is server processing only; the page should report its own measured tap->tick1/tick2 times to the server log.
